Eikoku Tantei Mysteria.name: Eikoku Tantei Mysteria
Eikoku Tantei Mysteria.summary: Eikoku Tantei Mysteria is a 2013 otome visual novel video game for the PlayStation Portable created by Karin Entertainment and published by Marvelous in Japan.

Hot Wheels - Ultimate Racing.name: Hot Wheels: Ultimate Racing
Hot Wheels - Ultimate Racing.summary: Hot Wheels Ultimate Racing is a 2007 racing video game developed by Italian company Raylight Studios and published by DSI Games for the PlayStation Portable (PSP) exclusively. The game is based on the Hot Wheels toy line which manufactured by Mattel.

Power Pro Success Legends.name: Pawapuro Success Legends
Power Pro Success Legends.summary: The first PSP installment in the Jikkyou Powerful Pro Yakyuu series.

Tom Clancy's EndWar.name: Tom Clancy's EndWar
Tom Clancy's EndWar.summary:
In addition to traditional RTS controls, EndWar goes beyond other Real Time Strategy games by letting you use your own voice to control your units, offering you true control at the speed of thought.
Instead of using the traditional top-down view, EndWar employs a unique third-person camera that puts you in the heart of the battle, making the use of terrain and cover even more critical to achieving victory. Zoom in and out at will and watch the devastation unfold as hundreds of units engage the enemy on fully destructible battlefields.
